calculation_provenance: Effect = mean(next-day outcome | cutoff followed) - mean(next-day outcome | cutoff not followed).
95% interval = deterministic seven-day moving-block bootstrap percentile interval.
Pearson interval uses Fisher's z transformation.
All labels and warnings are derived by src/liveforever_lab/analysis.py.
analysis.claim_boundary: Wellness experiment planning only. Observed associations are not diagnoses, prescriptions, or causal proof.

plan.title: 14-day caffeine timing replication
plan.hypothesis: Does stopping caffeine by 2 PM improve next-day recovery?
plan.design: Balanced randomized daily conditions with next-day outcome measurement.
controls: Keep total daily caffeine within the participant's usual range.
Record alcohol, illness, travel, and unusually hard training.
Use the same wearable and nightly measurement method.
Do not change medication or supplements for this experiment.
plan.decision_rule: Treat the result as a replication candidate only if both groups reach seven observed nights and the uncertainty interval excludes zero; otherwise label it inconclusive.
stop_conditions: Stop and seek appropriate professional care for severe or concerning symptoms.
Pause when illness, travel, or device failure makes the comparison unreliable.
plan.model_instruction: GPT-5.6 may explain this plan and ask clarifying questions, but it must not change calculated values or convert association into medical advice.
